improvement_recommendations.message: Build a consistent record of on-time repayments over future statement cycles.

feature_derivation.mean_statement_balance: arithmetic mean of the six account statement balances in original currency units
feature_derivation.months_with_delinquency: count of the six explicit monthly severity values greater than zero
feature_derivation.recent_delinquency_level: explicit delinquency severity from latest statement month; 0 means explicitly current
feature_derivation.payment_to_statement_ratio: sum of settled payment amounts applied to these statements / sum(max(statement balance, 0))

limitations: This is an experimental descriptive index, not a validated credit score or PD.
No lending tier, bureau equivalence, or lending decision is produced.
Keyword detected repayments are unverified; absent matches do not mean no debt.
methodology.missing_data_policy: Each unavailable indicator is omitted and remaining fixed weights are renormalized; an unobserved debt indicator is unknown, not zero.

recommendations: Review recurring spending and preserve a monthly cash-flow surplus where feasible.
